leadText:
Madison (Japanese: エル Elle) and Alexa (Japanese: リサ Lisa) are characters of the day who appeared in the episode The Kecleon Caper. 

They are a pair of rich young sisters who are traveling the world in the massive "Leviathan Two", a luxury blimp. They dress in fur coats and each have a . helped their Kecleon recover from motion sickness.

Their Kecleon marked the first appearance of a Pokémon from Generation III.
